Fifteen kilometres. Through a war zone.
Lewis Pugh just swam the Strait of Hormuz.
Three days, from Oman to the Cape of Hormuz.
Thirty minutes in, a tanker was hit four kilometres away.
Day two: he swam past a burning gas ship.
This is the man who once swam at the North Pole.
Why risk it? To show what war is doing to the ocean's wildlife.
